changes.title: Who could replace Lindsey Graham in the Senate after his sudden death?
changes.summary: South Carolina Sen. Lindsey Graham's sudden death late Saturday has set off a scramble for who will succeed him in the Senate.

changes.title: Republican strategist on what he'll remember most about Lindsey Graham
changes.summary: Sen. Lindsey Graham is being remembered for his wit and political effectiveness after his sudden death over the weekend. Republican strategist Matt Whitlock joins CBS News to discuss.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: The U.S. strikes Iran for a third weekend as Iran retaliates by hitting Gulf nations, Sen. Lindsey Graham died Saturday at the age of 71, Congress returns from recess this week.

changes.title: Trump urges S.C. governor to appoint Sen. Graham's sister as temporary replacement
changes.summary: Sen. Lindsey Graham died over the weekend at age 71, and Gov. Henry McMaster is expected to announce his pick later Monday.

changes.summary: President Donald Trump said Monday he wants South Carolina Gov. Henry McMaster to appoint Lindsey Graham’s sister, Darline Graham Nordone, to serve the remainder of the late senator’s term. changes.title: How Lindsey Graham tried to stay 'relevant'
changes.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Mark Leibovich, staff writer for The Atlantic , about the trajectory of late Sen. Lindsey Graham as he tried to maintain relevance within his Republican Party.

changes.title: On foreign policy, Graham's influence may have been felt the most
changes.summary: Over the course of his three decades in Congress, Lindsey Graham was a major influence on Capitol Hill and throughout the world as one of the most vocal advocates for U.S. military might.

changes.title: Sen. Lindsey Graham's sudden death spurs false claims
changes.summary: Sen. Lindsey Graham's unexpected death on Saturday night fueled baseless speculation on social media that his passing was the result of a criminal action. Here's a closer look at the facts.

changes.title: Ukraine fears it will have a weaker link to Trump after Sen. Lindsey Graham's sudden death
changes.summary: Ukraine has lost a close ally in President Donald Trump's orbit, leaving its leaders grappling with the implications for their war-torn country.
